content:
**Design doc**: .design/mod-policy-workbook.md
**Implements**: REQ-B3..B5; AC-3, AC-7

**Files to modify**:
- polaris-backend/src/api/policy.rs — DELETE KNOWN_POLICY_REFS slice + its checker fn
- polaris-backend/src/api/cases.rs::submit_action — validate each cited identifier via mod_policies::current_by_identifier; reject unknown (400 unknown_policy_ref) and retired (400 policy_retired); insert action + citations atomically in one tx
- polaris-backend/src/repo/action.rs — reversal writes its own citations at reversal time (REQ-B5)

**Rust quality**:
- LRU cache hit on action-create hot path; fall through to DB on miss (REQ-B4)
- Single sqlx::Transaction for action insert + per-citation inserts (atomicity)
- Backward-compat: still populate actions.policy_refs TEXT[] with the flat identifier list (REQ-B2)

**Tests**:
- tests/policy_version_pinning.rs — action against a since-superseded policy version returns 409 policy_version_stale
- Update tests/case_api.rs unknown-policy reject test against the new code path

**Blocked by**: #223
